sentence: This project uses radar and seismic experiments to study how high mountain glaciers change the landscape in the Bhutanese Himalaya.
This project studies how fast interactions between electrons, ions and small solid particles lead to long-lived patterns in dusty plasmas at high magnetic fields.
This project studies how transformers acquire reasoning abilities from training data and why such reasoning sometimes fails.
This project studies how to make robots and autonomous vehicles work safely when the networks they rely on have failures or deliberate attacks.
This project builds chemical methods that use rings with two nitrogens and one carbon to form carbon-nitrogen bonds.
This project builds computational methods that reconstruct complete microbial genomes from fragmented metagenomic sequencing data.
This project uses natural language processing to build a publicly accessible collection of biodata items and scales and tests how well they work.
This project studies the electron storage abilities of twisted and strained nanographenes upon stepwise chemical reduction.
This project studies how to make nitride and phosphide semiconductor nanocrystals based on alkaline earths.
This project builds a testbed for testing hybrid quantum materials and device configurations for quantum transduction.
This project holds an online workshop that brings together researchers from the United States and Japan to combine automated laboratory equipment and AI.
This project develops photocatalytic conditions that turn aryl tosylates, which are derived from phenols, into cyclic compounds.
This project builds a framework that lets scientific data carry machine-checkable proofs that integrity and provenance requirements are satisfied.
This project builds computational tools to detect yet-unseen pathogens and to tell engineered DNA from naturally occurring DNA.
This project builds a distributed storage infrastructure that institutions across the Great Plains region can use for data-intensive research.
This project develops sensing, imaging and robotic systems that help healthcare providers improve patient care.
